title: Footprint-Free Genome Editing of iPSC Using Alt-R CRISPR/Cas9
author: Jacob Marsh
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bfmmjk46
materials: Aspirate media from well containing cells
Gather the following reagents for Alt-R Reactions and let them thaw on ice
Nucleofect with Lonza Program CA-137 in P3 Solution

steps.title: Coat plate with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Matrigel to one well of a 6‑well plate, incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Prepare DMEM/F12 media tube
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL DMEM/F12 to a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Thaw and disinfect cell vial
steps.instruction: Thaw the cell vial in a 37 °C water bath for ~1 minute, wipe off excess water, spray the tube with 70 % ethanol, and place the vial in the biosafety cabinet.

steps.title: Transfer cells to media tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the thawed cells into the conical tube containing 5 mL DMEM/F12; if cells remain in the vial, rinse with 1 mL DMEM/F12 and add to the tube.

steps.title: Gently swirl cell suspension
steps.instruction: Swirl the tube at 750 rpm for 3 minutes (avoid rough mixing to keep cells clustered).

steps.title: Centrifuge and aspirate supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube (speed not specified), then aspirate most of the supernatant, leaving a small residual volume above the pellet (do not aspirate down to the pellet).

steps.title: Resuspend pellet with Rock inhibitor
steps.instruction: Add 4 µL Rock Inhibitor to the cell pellet and resuspend in 2 mL mTesR1 to obtain a 10 µM final concentration; gently swirl to mix.

steps.title: Seed cells onto coated well
steps.instruction: Aspirate excess Matrigel from the coated well and pipet the 2 mL cell suspension into the well.

steps.title: Recover cells and change media
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate for 24 hours, then change the media and allow the cells to recover.

steps.title: Split confluent cells into three wells
steps.instruction: When cultures reach 80‑90 % confluency, split them as single cells into three wells of a 6‑well tissue‑culture plate.

steps.title: Wash cells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash each well with 2 mL PBS.

steps.title: Add Accutase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes; gently tap the plate after incubation to help dislodge cells from Matrigel.

steps.title: Collect cells into conical tube
steps.instruction: Collect the cells in 5 mL PBS and transfer the suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.

steps.title: Resuspend and plate cells with Rock inhibitor
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 6 mL mTesR1 containing 5 µM Rock Inhibitor and plate 2 mL into each freshly Matrigel‑coated well (three wells).

steps.title: Coat three wells with Matrigel
steps.instruction: Coat three wells of a 6‑well plate with 1 mL Matrigel per well; incubate for 1 hour at 37 °C.

steps.title: Perform two additional single‑cell passages
steps.instruction: Repeat the single‑cell passage procedure (wash, Accutase, collect, resuspend, plate) at least two more times before nucleofection.

steps.title: Single‑cell passage 48 h before nucleofection
steps.instruction: Perform a single‑cell passage approximately 48 hours before nucleofection; prepare three million cells for the nucleofection reaction and one million cells for the GFP control (use three confluent wells).

steps.title: Prepare nucleofection plates with media
steps.instruction: Coat three wells for nucleofection as above, incubate 1 hour at 37 °C, then aspirate Matrigel and add 3 mL DMEM/F12 + 10 % FBS + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor per well.

steps.title: Prepare Alt‑R gRNA
steps.instruction: Mix 2.5 µL 200 µM Alt‑R crRNA with 2.5 µL 200 µM Alt‑R tracrRNA, heat at 95 °C for 5 minutes, then cool to room temperature; prepare fresh before each use.

steps.title: Resuspend Cas9 and enhancer
steps.instruction: Resuspend Alt‑R Cas9 and Electroporation Enhancer in PBS to a final concentration of 100 µM.

steps.title: Form RNP complex
steps.instruction: Combine the gRNA solution with the Cas9 + Enhancer solution, incubate at room temperature for 15 minutes; the RNP complex is stable for up to 48 hours at 4 °C and must not be frozen.

steps.title: Wash nucleofection wells with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash each nucleofection well with 2 mL PBS and aspirate.

steps.title: Add Accutase and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL Accutase per well and incubate at 37 °C for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Collect and dilute cells for counting
steps.instruction: Collect cells in 5 mL PBS, transfer to a 15 mL conical tube, resuspend pellet in 1 mL PBS, then dilute 1:10 (10 µL cells + 90 µL PBS) in a 1.7 mL tube.

steps.title: Count cells and calculate required volume
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the diluted suspension for counting on a Countess slide (use all four corners to obtain an average).

substeps.instruction: Multiply average cell count by 10,000 and by 3 to obtain total cells needed.
Divide the result by 3 to obtain the volume of cell suspension required for nucleofection.

steps.title: Transfer calculated cell volume to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer the calculated volume of cells (from the previous step) to a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare nucleofection reaction mix
steps.instruction: For each reaction, combine 82 µL P3 Solution with 18 µL Supplement in a 1.7 mL tube (total 100 µL). Prepare a master mix if multiple reactions are needed.

steps.title: Combine reaction mix with DNA
steps.instruction: Add the 100 µL reaction mix to the previously complexed Alt‑R DNA (RNP) solution.

steps.title: Mix reaction with cells
steps.instruction: Add the cell pellet (from step 26) to the reaction‑DNA mixture and gently pipette up and down with a P200 pipette; pipette only until mixed, avoiding excessive shear.

steps.title: Load mixture into cuvette
steps.instruction: Transfer 100 µL of the reaction‑DNA‑cell mixture to an electroporation cuvette, ensuring no bubbles are present.

steps.title: Incubate cuvette at room temperature
steps.instruction: Let the cuvette sit at room temperature for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer cells to coated well
steps.instruction: Immediately transfer the entire 100 µL mixture to a pre‑coated well containing 2 mL DMEM/F12 + 10 % FBS + 10 µM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Incubate overnight
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at 37 °C overnight.

steps.title: Culture iPSC post‑nucleofection
steps.instruction: Continue culturing the iPSC in one well of a 6‑well plate for 5‑7 days post‑nucleofection, changing mTesR1 daily.

steps.title: Add mTesR1 with 5 µM Rock inhibitor (24 h)
steps.instruction: At 24 hours post‑nucleofection, add mTesR1 supplemented with 5 µM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Add mTesR1 with 2.5 µM Rock inhibitor (48 h)
steps.instruction: At 48 hours post‑nucleofection, add mTesR1 supplemented with 2.5 µM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Add mTesR1 with 1 µM Rock inhibitor (72 h)
steps.instruction: At 72 hours post‑nucleofection, add mTesR1 supplemented with 1 µM Rock Inhibitor.

steps.title: Continue culture until confluence
steps.instruction: Continue culturing the cells in mTesR1 until they become confluent (approximately 5 days).
